_help: Art for games that have none of their own. 'aliases': the same game under another name in another list. Key: '<collection>/<item>' as the game lists name it; value: the '<collection>/<item>' whose medium_artwork it uses. 'files': single files, '<collection>/<item>': { '<art type>': '<file>' }, e.g. a PC game's own intro movie as its video (skipped on a cabinet that doesn't have the file). New-RetroFECollections.ps1 hard-links each art type the game has none of (video, fanart, logo, artwork, controls cards ...), never replaces its own art, and lists each link in medium_artwork\ARCADEMASTER-borrowed-art.txt so it can be removed. Stories are not linked: write those in tools\game-stories.json.
